ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution; >90% of visible fluke surface exhibits low-intensity (black) pixel values. The macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) scar tissue to low-intensity base pigmentation is approximately 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid black contiguous mass. High-contrast white geometric streaks (linear) are mapped primarily across the central region and right lobe, with small circular high-intensity clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the trailing edge; the right tip exhibits a higher frequency of jagged pixel-amplitude variations compared to the relatively smooth linear boundary of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a slightly convex trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips; terminal ends show a pronounced posterior and dorsal sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) at the distal edge of the right lobe and scattered along the inferior margin of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; prominent rake marks consisting of 3-5 parallel lines are visible across the central and right fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of white linear scars (likely odontocete rake marks) concentrated on the right fluke lobe; minor irregular notch at the terminal edge of the right fluke tip.
